summary: Frontend E2E (preview) of 5 features: Producción IGSS dd/mm/aaaa filter, Libro IGSS 'SPS por revisar' card (live orders only), Respaldos → Restaurar (review, sessions warning, RESTAURAR word, mandatory pre-backup, progress, result, recent restorations), and permissions. All requested checks PASS. Only minor text/UX polish items found.

results.1_produccion_fecha: PASS - prod-fecha is a text input showing today in Guatemala time (17/11/2026 while UTC was already 18/11). Typing '01112026' becomes '01/11/2026' and calls /api/igss-units/produccion?fecha=2026-11-01. The calendar is in Spanish (noviembre 2026, lu..do, week starts Monday); picking 15 gives 15/11/2026 and reloads. '31/02/2026' shows prod-fecha-error 'Fecha inválida: use dd/mm/aaaa', makes no request and prod-export is disabled. Rango mode: prod-desde/prod-hasta use the same format; typing gives desde=2026-10-01; an invalid hasta ('32/13') shows the error, makes no request and disables export; a calendar pick re-enables export and reloads.
results.2_libro_sps: PASS - libro-revision-sps-total = 1. The table holds only sps-por-revisar-DEMO_cap_orden (ORD-DEMO01, Reservada); DEMO_cap_hist is not listed. Patient DEMO-CAP-1 record shows the 'Revisar SPS' badge on both orden-revisar-sps-DEMO_cap_orden and DEMO_cap_hist. ORD-DEMO01 was NOT confirmed.
results.3_revision_restaurar: PASS - Backup type labels Automático/Manual (and later 'Previo a restaurar') show; dates are in Guatemala time. The new manual backup was Completado in about 6s. The dialog showed rest-cargando and then rest-revision with rest-fecha, all 6 group cards (all 0/0/0, as expected), rest-total, the toggle ('0 con diferencias, 80 sin cambios'), rest-sesiones listing rest-sesion-admin ('Administrador NovaVision (admin) · última actividad 17/11/26, 09:00 p. m.') and rest-vence (+15 min). rest-confirmar is disabled for ''/'restaurar'/'RESTAURA' and enabled only for 'RESTAURAR'.
results.4_restauracion: PASS - rest-progreso showed the 4 steps in order with their seconds (2.8 / 1.1 / 9.6 / 0 s). Escape did not close the dialog and rest-cerrar was disabled while running. rest-resultado-ok: 'Restauración terminada en 13.5 s ... Respaldo previo guardado: respaldo-2026-11-18_030120.json.gz'. After closing, the list's top row is that file, 'Previo a restaurar', Completado. The restauraciones-recientes card shows 'Terminada 13.5 s'. audit_logs holds REVISADA/INICIADA/COMPLETADA entries after the restore (the log survived). The superadmin session still works on /pacientes and /igss/libro (SPS total still 1). The admin's other session also kept working.
results.5_permisos: PASS - admin, igss.admin and usuario are all redirected from /respaldos to /pacientes, with no Restaurar buttons and no Respaldos menu entry (menu checked for igss.admin and usuario). GET /api/backups/restauraciones returns 403 for igss.admin and usuario.

issues: Double period: 'Los datos volvieron al 17/11/26, 09:01 p. m..' (rest-resultado-ok) and 'Esta revisión vale hasta las 17/11/26, 09:16 p. m..' — formatDateTime ends with 'p. m.' and the sentence adds another '.'

Year format differs: the dialog (rest-fecha, rest-vence, session time) uses 2-digit years (17/11/26) while the Respaldos list and Restauraciones recientes use 17/11/2026. Use 4 digits in the dialog too, which matters when telling backups from different years apart
When nothing differs, opening rest-todas-toggle shows an empty table with only headers. Show 'Sin diferencias' instead
During progress, the first poll only comes after about 2s, so for the first 1-2s all 4 steps show empty circles and no spinner (paso_actual is not yet in the initial POST response)
The X close icon stays visible and looks clickable while the restore runs (it is blocked correctly). Hide or disable it while enCurso
The calendar's 'today' highlight uses the browser's local date (it showed the 18th while Guatemala was still on the 17th). Cosmetic only
Fecha de Nacimiento still uses the native mm/dd/yyyy date input, unlike the new FechaDMA dd/mm/aaaa control

action_items: Remove the trailing '.' after formatDateTime(...) in RestaurarRespaldoDialog (Resultado and rest-vence lines), or change the wording
Optional: use 4-digit years in the restore dialog, add an empty state for the all-modules table, show a spinner on respaldo_previo right away, and hide the dialog's X while running
critical_code_review_comments: RestaurarRespaldoDialog useSeguir: on a poll error it calls setTarea({...tarea}) to retry forever every 2s with no cap or user feedback. If the backend stays down, the user sees an endless spinner
Respaldos.js fmtFecha duplicates formatDateTime with a different year format; reuse one helper
seed_data_creation: Created manual backup respaldo-2026-11-18_030107.json.gz (id 6aab3e8c-ba0c-4a03-a969-2fea91f2c9ba) and restored it; the restore created the pre-restore backup respaldo-2026-11-18_030120.json.gz. No other data changed (the diff was 0 in all modules).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The /igss/libro route works (the request said /libro-igss). The Periodo select is data-testid='prod-modo'. Opening a second browser context via page.context.browser.new_context() works for multi-session tests. Restoring a just-created backup takes about 14s in preview. The login rate limit is 5/min, so space out logins.
